guide.title: User Guide
guide.gettingStartedDesc: SuperImage is an AI-powered text-to-image generation platform. Follow these steps to get started:
guide.step1Desc: Click the Settings icon in the header, then add your OpenAI API key.
guide.step2Desc: Type a description of the image you want to create, adjust size/quality/count, and press Enter.
guide.step3Desc: Click the Edit button on any generated image to start an edit session with a source image.
guide.tip1: Use the example prompts on the home page for inspiration.
guide.tip2: Adjust quality to "high" for better results (costs more tokens).
guide.tip3: Use keyboard shortcuts: ⌘N for new chat, ⌘K for search, ⌘, for settings.
guide.noMemory: Each generation request is independent — the AI does not remember previous messages in the same session.
guide.step4Desc: Click the 📎 button or drag & drop images to attach references. The AI will use them as inspiration for generation.
